plugins.prepareCmd: test "$RELEASE_VERSION" = '${nextRelease.version}' || { echo 'Release version changed since the apps were built; rerun the release workflow.' >&2; exit 1; }

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
${nextRelease.notes}

## Installing

**Android** (7.0 or later): open the `.apk` on the device and, if asked, allow installing apps from that source (your browser or file manager).

**macOS** (14 Sonoma or later, Apple silicon and Intel): unzip the `.zip` and move `Discretion.app` to Applications. The app is not notarized, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security and choose **Open Anyway**, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Discretion.app`.
